newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rexrodt sees Bonn passing Eurofighter funding.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt sees Bonn passing Eurofighter funding.

text.p: German Economic Minister Guenther Rexrodt said on Monday he was confident Bonn would soon approve funding needed to push the Eurofighter jet program into production.
"I am confident it will happen at the July 11 cabinet meeting," Rexrodt said after a news conference at the Paris airshow.

Germany has been struggling to find funds to place orders for the four-nation military jet in the face of a gaping budget deficit and a drive to qualify for European monetary union. The cabinet meets July 11 fo rthe final time before parliament's summer break.
Rexrodt repeated that idea that repayment of state-aid for the Airbus consortium could to go toward the Eurofighter.

Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG, Germany's partner in the Eurofighter and in Airbus Industrie, could repay Bonn ahead of schedule for Airbus development aid, giving the government room in its 1998 budget for the Eurofighter.
An independent accounting firm would soon give Bonn an estimate of the value of the Airbus repayments, Rexrodt said.
